chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Aban, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: "Give the sisters from the mother their prescribed share along with the grandfather."

key_terms.الْأَخَوَاتِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: Sisters from the mother (half-siblings sharing only the mother)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of sisters from the mother when a grandfather is present?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific inheritance dynamics where maternal sisters share the estate concurrently with the paternal grandfather, a key point of discussion in Shia jurisprudence regarding the grandfather's exclusion or inclusion of descendants. It underscores the principle that the grandfather does not necessarily block the maternal siblings, ensuring they receive their prescribed fixed portion alongside him. This ruling highlights the nuanced application of Quranic inheritance rules within the Shia school of thought.
